meta.name: conversion-value-mapper
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "set up conversion values so tROAS optimizes profit not orders", "map margin onto my purchase value", "build value rules for lead / phone / signup conversions", or "stop bidding to revenue when I care about profit"; defines and QAs the conversion VALUE model — per-conversion values, margin/net-value adjustment, static-vs-dynamic value rules, proxy values for non-revenue actions, and a value-vs-count sanity check — as a value-model spec plus a pre-launch value QA sheet. Not for whether the tag fires or UTMs are clean — use conversion-signal-qa; not for cross-platform double-count de-dup — use attribution-reconciler; not for scoring R1/R2 — that is a scored veto in ad-account-auditor. 付费广告转化价值建模/利润出价/价值规则QA

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为付费广告设置转化价值，让出价优化利润而非订单量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理付费广告账户，希望按利润而非收入优化出价
copy.tagline_en: Set conversion values for paid ads to optimize bids for profit, not orders
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid ad accounts and want to optimize bids for profit instead of revenue

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你定义和检查付费广告的转化价值模型，包括每个转化的价值、利润率调整、静态或动态价值规则、非收入行为的代理价值，以及价值与数量的核对，最终输出一份价值模型说明和上线前的质量检查表。
howto.when: 当你要设置或检查基于价值的出价（如 tROAS、最大转化价值）时使用，特别是当你想让出价优化利润而非订单数，或者需要为线索、电话等非收入转化设定代理价值时。

say.text: 帮我设置转化价值，让 tROAS 出价优化利润而不是收入。
say.note: 技能会要求你提供 GA4 购买价值和利润率数据。

say.text: 为我的线索、电话和注册转化建立价值规则，分配代理价值。
say.note: 技能会基于转化率和平均订单价值推导代理价值。

say.text: 我的利润率按 SKU 差异很大，请将净利润映射到转化价值上。
say.note: 技能会使用你提供的利润率数据调整价值。

howto.what_en: This skill defines and QAs the conversion value model for paid ads, including per-conversion values, margin/net-value adjustment, static vs dynamic value rules, proxy values for non-revenue actions, and a value-vs-count sanity check, outputting a value-model spec and a pre-launch QA sheet.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up or checking value-based bidding (e.g., tROAS, max-conversion-value), especially to optimize for profit rather than revenue, or to assign proxy values for non-revenue conversions like leads or phone calls.

say_en.text: Set up conversion values so tROAS bids to profit, not revenue.
say_en.note: Skill will ask for GA4 purchase value and margin data.

say_en.text: Build value rules for my lead, phone, and signup conversions with proxy values.
say_en.note: Skill derives proxy values from close rate and AOV.

say_en.text: Map net margin onto conversion values since margins vary by SKU.
say_en.note: Skill adjusts values using your margin data.
